metadata.name: routed-smoke
metadata.description:
End-to-end proof that test-genie's routed test-database path actually works: navigates to the DB-backed delivery matrix and asserts that a fixture slug seeded into the per-run test pool ('routed-smoke-001') is rendered. The slug exists only in the test pool; if the API failed to route the request to the test pool (e.g., X-Vrooli-Test-Mode header not attached, TestModeMiddleware missing, RoutedDB.pick(ctx) returning the primary), the assertion fails.

PENDING: this case cannot pass until (a) the delivery matrix renders target rows from the targets domain and (b) bas/seeds/seed.go inserts a target whose identifier is 'routed-smoke-001' into the test pool. Both are P0 work; the case is wired to the real surface so it starts proving routing the moment they land.

metadata.label: Navigate to the DB-backed delivery matrix

assert.failure_message: Seeded fixture 'routed-smoke-001' not visible in the target matrix — either the seed has not been written yet, or the UI->API request did not reach the routed test pool. Check that X-Vrooli-Test-Mode is attached by Playwright (browser_profile.extra_headers), that TestModeMiddleware is mounted, and that the targets repository uses *database.RoutedDB.

metadata.label: Assert seeded slug is rendered (proves routing end-to-end)
